extensionDescription.message: Zoom, rotate, drag, adjust, and save images or backgrounds via right-click and mouse wheel, without breaking page layouts.

lblCtrlRightWheel.description: Shortcut label for Ctrl + Right click + Mouse wheel.

optRotationStep.description: Option label for rotation angle per wheel notch.

lblAltRightLeftClick.description: Shortcut label for Alt + Right click + Left click.

lblCtrlAltRightLeftClick.message: Ctrl + Alt + Right click + Left click
lblCtrlAltRightLeftClick.description: Shortcut label for Ctrl + Alt + Right click + Left click.

btnResetSettings.description: Button text to restore default extension settings.

optDraggableSingleImage.message: Single image view: Direct mouse wheel zoom. Freely draggable after enlarging
optDraggableSingleImage.description: Option label for standalone image viewer enhancements.

optRightClickTimeout.message: Time until right click is canceled
optRightClickTimeout.description: Option label for right-click cancellation timeout.

hlpRightClickTimeout.message: If this time passes after right-clicking without scrolling the wheel, the right-click state is automatically released. (1000ms = 1 second)
hlpRightClickTimeout.description: Help tooltip for right-click timeout setting.

hlpEnableKeyShortcuts.message:
Acts on the image under the mouse pointer or the active image:
+ / −  Zoom (Shift: double step)
Arrow keys  Move a floating image (Shift: larger steps)
0  Fit to window
R / L  Rotate right / left by 90° (Shift: 45°)
P  Open or close the panel
F  Pin or unpin the image on screen (Shift+F: unpin all images)
Esc  Reset (Shift+Esc: all images)
hlpEnableKeyShortcuts.description: Help text for the keyboard shortcuts option on the options page. Lines are separated by line breaks; the key names (R, L, P, F, Esc, Shift) stay as they appear on the keyboard.

optShowZoomBadge.message: Show zoom percentage and rotation angle on the image
optShowZoomBadge.description: Option label to show the zoom percentage and rotation angle on the badge overlay.

lblExcludedDomains.message: Disable on these domains (one per line):

hlpExcludedDomains.message:
e.g. maps.google.com or figma.com (subdomains are automatically included)
Wildcard * is supported, e.g. google.*
hlpExcludedDomains.description: Placeholder and hint text for domain exclusions.

optEnableKeyShortcuts.description: Option label to toggle keyboard shortcut support.

optFrameColor.description: Label on the options page for the color of the frames around zoomed images (hover and panel states).

optPinColor.description: Label on the options page for the color of the frame around pinned images and of the pin button when active.

btnResetColor.description: Tooltip for the small button that resets a frame color and its on/off state to the defaults.

optFrameOff.description: Checkbox next to a frame color on the options page; turns that frame off completely.

optFrameIdle.description: Tooltip on the first frame preview tile: the image is neither hovered nor has its panel open.

optFrameHover.description: Tooltip on the second frame preview tile: the mouse pointer is over the image.

optFramePanel.description: Tooltip on the third frame preview tile: the panel is open for the image.

btnSupport.description: Label for donation and support button.

optZoomToCursor.description: Option label to zoom centered towards cursor position.

panel_title.description: Header title of the adjustment panel.

panel_label_zoom.description: Panel label for zoom percentage slider.

panel_label_width.description: Panel label for width in pixels slider.

panel_btn_reset.description: Panel button to reset all image adjustments.

panel_btn_save.description: Panel button to save modified image to disk.

panel_btn_close.description: Panel button to close the adjustment dialog.

panel_cors_error.message:
Could not save image.

Reason: The source server blocks exporting due to security policies (CORS).
panel_cors_error.description: Alert message when image export fails due to CORS restrictions.

panel_export_source_too_large.message:
Could not save image.

Reason: The source server blocks exporting (CORS) and the image file is too large for the fallback download.
panel_export_source_too_large.description: Alert when export fails due to CORS and the fallback download size limit is exceeded.

panel_export_downscaled.message:
Image was saved at a reduced size.

Reason: The requested size exceeds the maximum export limit.
panel_export_downscaled.description: Notice shown after export when the image had to be scaled down because it exceeds the maximum export size.

panel_label_flip.description: Panel section label for flipping image.

panel_btn_flip_h.description: Panel button to flip image horizontally.

panel_btn_flip_v.description: Panel button to flip image vertically.

msgResetConfirm.message: Really reset all settings to their default values?
msgResetConfirm.description: Confirmation shown before resetting all settings to their defaults.

msgUpdateNotice.description: Notice shown on the settings page after the extension was updated (version number is appended).

lnkChangelog.description: Link text pointing to the changelog.

btnDismissNotice.description: Tooltip for the button that dismisses the update notice.

panel_tooltip_invert.description: Tooltip for the invert-colors button in the panel.

panel_tooltip_gray.description: Tooltip for the grayscale button in the panel.

panel_tooltip_pixel.description: Tooltip for the pixel-mode button (disables image smoothing when enlarging).

panel_tooltip_pin.message: Pin or unpin image on screen (F)
panel_tooltip_pin.description: Tooltip for the pin button in the panel (Also toggled with the F key).

panel_tooltip_meta.message: Original resolution and current size relative to it
panel_tooltip_meta.description: Tooltip for the panel header line showing original resolution and current size relative to it.

panel_tooltip_format.description: Tooltip for the arrow part of the save split button (opens the export format menu).

panel_menu_copy.description: Menu item that copies the edited image to the clipboard.

panel_copy_ok.description: Confirmation shown after the image was copied to the clipboard.

panel_copy_failed.message:
Could not copy the image.

Reason: The browser blocked clipboard access here. Try saving the image instead.
panel_copy_failed.description: Alert when copying the image to the clipboard fails.

panel_export_hires_fallback.message: The larger image file could not be exported (server restrictions). The displayed original was used instead.
panel_export_hires_fallback.description: Notice shown when the larger image file could not be exported and the displayed original was used.

popup_enable.description: Toolbar popup button that enables the add-on on the current website.

popup_unsupported.description: Toolbar popup status line for pages where the add-on cannot run (e.g. browser pages).

optHiResUpgrade.message: Load larger image version in floating zoom (extra download)
optHiResUpgrade.description: Settings checkbox: load a larger image file linked by the page while in floating mode (opt-in).

popup_scope_title.description: Toolbar popup heading above the choice of how widely to disable the add-on.

popup_scope_domain.description: Toolbar popup choice: disable for the whole domain including all subdomains (the rule itself is shown below).
